criteria.evidence: userProfile.test.ts > PATCH /api/users/me > 'stores the updated password as a bcrypt hash, not plaintext' — ✓ passed (142ms). Direct DB query assertion passed; pnpm test exited 0.

criteria.description: PATCH /api/users/me with valid JWT and { username, email: <taken-email> } returns HTTP 409; subsequent GET /api/auth/me shows username and email both unchanged (no partial write).
